description: Shows the DNS records a custom domain needs (an ownership TXT record and an MX record), whether each one is published yet, the MX hosts the domain uses now, and the setup status. Call it before add_custom_domain and again after changing DNS. If replaces_other_mail_provider is true, the domain already receives mail elsewhere: ask the user before changing its MX record, because all of that mail will go to HideMail instead.
name: get_custom_domain_setup
title: Get custom domain setup
